title: 第56章 带着千斤野物下山，玉葫芦液的作用
content_zh:
第56章 带着千斤野物下山，玉葫芦液的作用-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

趟子房内。

很快传来了一阵刺耳的尖叫声。

“啊，爹，你抽我干什么？”

“爹，爹爹，别抽了，疼啊……哎呦……！”

“疼死我了，山哥，救命啊……！”

二壮捂着屁股冲了出来，面目扭曲，身后还跟着愤怒的李财骂道：“你个苟日的东西，青山在外面忙活，你在里面睡大觉，看老子不抽死你。”

“爹，别打了，别打了……！”

“二叔，三伯，救命啊……！”

二壮一边说着，一边朝着老林子里面钻，李财叔抓着木棍在后面追。

“哈哈……！”

二十多口子李姓本家人，顿时哄堂大笑起来，当然还有几家人品好，关系好的外姓人。

“青山，你打的野物呢？”

“让爷们们开开眼啊！”

李铁匠开口道。

“行！”

李青山点了点头，旋即不忘对李铁匠道：“铁匠叔，这阵子你得帮个忙，我想打些箭头出来！”

“行，小事情，包在我身上了。”李铁匠拍着胸口保证道。

李青山带着一群人到了小趟子房前，赵红旗也走了出来，帮忙将小趟子房下面地窖内的野猪一块块的搬了出来。

都是三十来斤一块的。

好家伙！！

足足七百斤的野猪肉堆放在大家面前，这带来的视觉冲击力，还是极其强悍的。

一个个相互对视一眼，满是羡慕。

这些猪肉要是拿到集市上售卖，二百多块钱肯定是没问题的，今年李青山不用上山，一家子都能天天吃香的喝辣的。

望着眼前的野猪肉。

这让不少叔叔大爷们动了心思，不断在脑海中搜索着自家亲戚中，和李青山年纪差不多姑娘，一个个看向李青山的眼神，就像是看到了香饽饽一样。

“青山，你本领不小啊，这打到一只野猪还好说，第二只野猪可就不好打咯！”

“咱们村多少年了，没人打到过两头野猪。”

“赵占山前一段时间不就是打算打野猪的吗？结果野猪没打到，还把自己给伤了。”

“我打小就看青山这小子行！”

“行了，大家赶紧吃饭，吃完了好带着猎物上路回去，这天气，这肉可不能耽搁，半个小时之内吃完，没问题吧？”

李铁匠主持大局道。

“好！”

石溪村的爷们纷纷点头，一个个开始忙活起来，吃饱喝足后，便一人分了一些肉，有一些放在担架上，这样两个人抬着能抬的多一些。

野鸡还有十只，野兔也还有十只！

Go inside the room.

Soon there was a piercing scream.

"Ah, Dad, why are you whipping me?"

"Dad, Daddy, stop twitching, it hurts... Ouch...!"

"It hurts me so much, Brother Shan, please help...!"

Erzhuang rushed out with his butt in his hand, his face distorted, followed by an angry Li Cai who scolded: "You bastard, Qingshan is busy outside, you are sleeping inside, I will see if I beat you to death."

"Dad, stop fighting, stop fighting...!"

"Second uncle, third uncle, help me...!"

As Er Zhuang spoke, he headed into the old forest. Uncle Li Cai grabbed the wooden stick and chased after him.

"Haha...!"

There were more than 20 members of my family named Li, and the whole room burst into laughter. Of course, there were also a few people with other surnames who were good-natured and well-connected.

"Qingshan, where are the wild animals you hunted?"

"Let the men open their eyes!"

Tiejiang Li said.

"Okay!"

Li Qingshan nodded, and immediately said to Blacksmith Li: "Uncle Blacksmith, you have to do a favor right now. I want to shoot some arrows!"

"Okay, the little things will be taken care of by me." Li Tiejiang promised, patting his chest.

Li Qingshan led a group of people to Xiaodanzi's house. Zhao Hongqi also came out and helped move the wild boar out of the cellar under Xiaodanzi's house piece by piece.

They are all about thirty pounds each.

Good guy!!

A full 700 kilograms of wild boar meat were piled in front of everyone, and the visual impact it brought was extremely powerful.

They all looked at each other with envy.

If these pork were sold in the market, it would definitely cost more than 200 yuan. This year, Li Qingshan did not have to go up the mountain, and the whole family could enjoy spicy food every day.

Looking at the wild boar meat in front of me.

This made many uncles and uncles think about it, and they kept searching in their minds for girls who were about the same age as Li Qingshan among their relatives. They looked at Li Qingshan one by one, as if they were seeing delicious food.

"Qingshan, you are quite capable. It's easy to hit one wild boar, but it's not easy to hit the second wild boar!"

"No one has shot two wild boars in our village for many years."

"Didn't Zhao Zhanshan plan to hunt the wild boar some time ago? But the wild boar missed him and even injured himself."

"I've been watching this guy Qingshan since I was a kid!"

"Okay, everyone, hurry up and eat. After you finish eating, you can take the prey back on the road. In this weather, you can't delay the meat. You can finish it within half an hour. Is that okay?"

Li Tiejiang presided over the overall situation.

"Okay!"

The men in Shixi Village nodded one after another and began to work one by one. After eating and drinking, they divided some meat among themselves and put some on the stretcher, so that two people could carry more.

There are ten more pheasants, and ten more hares!
